provenance: Same current assistant has seen previous ratings, summary and model outputs. This is an additional reading, not a blind, independent, human or second-model rating.
scope: Read all30 input cases/all150 document slots; exact duplicate documents may be read once with all slot mappings checked; prioritize unknown3/moderate4, then allremaining23; no external lookup.

rules.answer: Every necessary premise supported by supplied text; no relevant incompatible assertion.
rules.refuse: At least one necessary premise missing; absence alone is not a factual negative.
rules.conflict: Two explicitly incompatible answer-relevant claims in same entity/time/property scope; may occur within one document.
rules.unknown: Question scope/identity/time or evidence too ambiguous for a definite mode. Do not force a mode.
rules.scope: Read complete question and all five documents. No outside facts or model outputs. Comparison/choice questions require the stated joint conditions.
rules.time: Respect explicit dates. Different times alone are not conflict; unresolved temporal question scope may be unknown.
rules.compatibility: Different people, roles, descriptions or multiple compatible categories do not establish conflict.
rules.citation: Exact original substrings with document slots. answer needs support; conflict needs both opposing claims, not necessarily distinct documents.
rules.disclosure: Input-only ordering reduces new output contamination but does not erase existing project/ID exposure.

preservation: Write followup-only ratings; do not overwrite earlier sealed inputs, export templates, model predictions or formal annotations. unknown allowed; no new GPU or confirmation access.
